001: Excuse me, what seems to be the problem today?
My throat has been sore since yesterday, and I think I have a fever too.
I see. Well then, shall we take your temperature?
Yes, please. Also, I have a slight headache.
Okay. Well then, I'll examine you now.
002: Yes, that's right. Please show me your insurance card.
Yes, here you go. Is this okay?
That's fine. Now, please fill out the medical questionnaire.
Okay. Can I borrow a pen?
003: Sorry for the wait. Please, come in.
Thank you. Actually, I came because I have a stomachache.
Since when have you had the pain?
It's been hurting constantly since this morning. I haven't been able to eat much either.
I see. Well then, let me feel your stomach a little.
004: I'll prescribe some medicine, so please go to the pharmacy.
Yes, I understand. Are there any precautions I should take?
Take this medicine after meals. Also, avoid driving a car.
Okay. How long should I keep taking it?
I'll give you a three-day supply. Also, if you don't get better, please come back.
005: I'd like to get my medicine with this prescription, please.
Yes, just a moment, please. Here is your medicine.
Thank you. How many times a day should I take this?
Take it twice a day, in the morning and evening, after meals.
Okay. Are there any side effects?
It may cause drowsiness. So, please refrain from driving.
006: Excuse me, where is the cold medicine?
The cold medicine is on that shelf over there.
Thank you. Also, I'd like a thermometer.
The thermometers are placed near the register.
I see. Well then, I'll go look at both.
If you can't find them, just call out to me again.
007: Is this medicine taken before meals?
No, that one is after meals. These white tablets here are for before meals.
Oh, I see. Good thing I didn't mix them up.
Yes, it's written on the label, so please check carefully.
008: The fever has gone down, but the cough is still continuing.
I see. Does she have an appetite?
She's been able to eat a little bit at a time now.
That's good. Well then, give her this syrup three times a day.
009: Excuse me, is it okay to take this medicine together with over-the-counter drugs?
Let's see. Please don't take this medicine with over-the-counter cold medicine.
Is that so? I'll be careful.
If you have any changes in your condition, please contact the hospital right away.
010: Yes, may I have your registration card?
Yes, here you go. How much is the payment this time?
It will be two thousand five hundred yen. Cash or card?
Cash, please. I have the exact amount.
